title: Hunts FH-020W: Record the release evidence for the held-claim migration and retire its policy entry

source.ref: Split from FH-020V (2026-11-16): the player wording, the held result routing and the authoring switch shipped; the release evidence is the lead's.

detail: Owed by release engineering and Daniel, not by an agent. Migration 20270346053000_hunt_claim_hold.sql is registered (#5005), merged (#5004) and listed in the Frequency Community migration ledger as of a read on 2026-11-16; the ledger proves version and name, not the bytes that ran. Record in docs/hunts/EVIDENCE.md, naming 20270346053000: the exact-head workflow_dispatch db-tests run (full replay and pgTAP, supabase/tests/hunt_claim_hold.test.sql), the real API acceptance step, the approved apply sequence with who applied it and when, and strict ledger parity (pnpm check:migrations with a database) after the apply. Then remove the consumed registrations for 20270346052000 and 20270346053000 from scripts/migration-readiness-policy.json in a policy-only housekeeping PR. Review and appeal UI follow the separate staff authorization ruling. Hunts switches stay OFF until this passes. Done when: EVIDENCE.md carries the record and the policy file no longer registers the migration. Requires: FH-020V. Owner role: Release engineering.
